text:
jordan: Heads-up: enterprise pilot wants clear launch checklist for audit + BYOK. Can we agree on minimum GA scope and immediate follow-ups?

mika: Minimum GA (must): BYOK/CMEK handshake doc + auto-handoff logs, per-tenant retention API (presets + custom), legal-hold suspend that overrides TTLs, and signed export package for eDiscovery.

diego: Infra: prefer metadata indexing default to control cost. Store raw events in cold archive and provide sampled indexing for long-tail queries. Need index_mode per-tenant toggle.

raja: Security: add signed checkpointing every N hours and a signed manifest for exports. Define who can trigger key-rotation and make rotations auditable.

mika: UX: retention presets 30/90/365, show active legal-holds with actor and ticket ref, and an export button that generates a signed JSONL bundle.

jordan: Ops: export SLA 95% < 3h for <=30d, runbook for evidence requests, emergency preserve flow. Also need oncall playbook for retention overrides.

diego: small config sketch to include in the ticket:
```
retention_default: 90
tiers: [30,90,365]
index_mode: metadata_only
legal_hold_enabled: true
```

raja: Prioritization: Phase 1 = BYOK handshake + signed export + retention API/UI + legal-hold suspend + minimal provenance metadata. Phase 2 = full indexing opt-in, cross-region replay, advanced query SLA.

ops-bot: Created ticket #PROD-8912 "Enterprise audit + BYOK GA checklist" and assigned to @jordan, @mika, @diego.

jordan: I'll drop a short security spec and link it to the ticket by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all.
